title: Nishimori Threshold Estimation for Bayesian Inference and $\mathbb{Z}_q$ Surface Code Decoding
summary: In quantum error correction, the error threshold provides essential quantitative guidance for the ability to bring about fault-tolerance through decoding the effects of incoherent noise, weak measurement or inference. However, the numerical value of an error threshold is typically only accessible through large-scale numerical simulations of the underlying noise model.
